## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 01.09.2026 - 05.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Shelley Raulerson_, 05.09.2026, 1/5: "Signed up for the cheap trial, never used it. Then came the subscription chg of $30.51. Opened the app to cancel and also explained that I had never used it and asked for a refund. The responses came from Nancy, but at the bottom it says they are AI generated. Who knows if you're talking to a real person or not. By the end of me repeatedly asking for a refund, and her saying no bc of the terms/conditions and giving me 4 months free with other useless stuff, I'm not happy. Customer svc is trash."
            2. _Susan Woolley_, 02.09.2026, 1/5: "Don't get sucked in. I cancelled this subscription within days of signing up 12 months ago. I have just been slugged over $100 for something that isn't suitable. Support is a joke."
            3. _Martha Webster_, 01.09.2026, 1/5: "the yoga got too hard for me. I tried to cancel and it had autorenewed before I could get the cancel to work. paid $13 cad for 28 day trial and it renewed for $80. when I contacted them - no refund and just wanted to give me more months."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 13.06.2026 - 25.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Mel_, 13.06.2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
            2. _Patricia Bliss_, 25.08.2026, 5/5: "At 70, I have lower back, hip & knee issues, I find Tai Chi Chair doable, even while feeling fragile. I also lost 3 pounds just in the first 10 days. Way better than Tai Chi Walking, which I tried first, and ended up hurting in all the above areas after the first session. Tai Chi Chair has not caused any pain, so I can keep on doing the exercises."
<!--/ir-theme-->
